overlay.legend: line of sight: red away from the radar, blue towards it, scale ±50 cm

text_hint.title: Coast moved west in the earthquakes
text_hint.sentence: The coast moved about {coast_west_low}-{coast_west_high} cm west relative to central Caracas.
text_hint.because: Two NISAR orbits looking from opposite sides agree on the westward motion, while the pairs before the earthquakes kept the same spots within {control_max} cm. The range covers La Guaira and Macuto with and without the product's correction for the ionosphere, the charged upper air that also disturbs the radar signal: the correction raises the values but has known flaws over water and forest.
text_hint.not_claimed: We make no claim about building damage, people, landslides or fault slip.

summary_hint: NISAR shows the coast at La Guaira and Macuto moved about {coast_west_low}-{coast_west_high} cm west relative to central Caracas in the 24 Jun 2026 earthquakes.
